title: A board of a table's rows in columns by a status column, moved by drag or arrows
about: Orders from new to ready, requests from open to done, deals by stage: the kanban component over a table, with the status column as the board's columns, a form to add a card in a column, and editing a card when tapped.

key.about: names the pattern's data and state

status.about: the column whose value is the card's column

statuses.about: the columns in order: values, or {"value", "label"}

name.about: the column shown as the card's title

meta.about: columns shown under the title, joined by dots

fields.about: the form's fields, to add a card and edit one (no adding when left out)

where.about: an SQL condition on the rows

sql.about: the whole SELECT (default: from table, where and order)
sql.default: SELECT * FROM {{table}}{{where|pre: WHERE }} ORDER BY {{order}} LIMIT 500

deleteLabel.about: the label of the delete button

let.{{key}}_columns: ={{statuses|json}}.map(s => s && typeof s === 'object' ? {id: s.value, title: s.label || String(s.value)} : {id: s, title: String(s).charAt(0).toUpperCase() + String(s).slice(1).replace(/_/g, ' ')})
let.{{key}}_items: ={{key}}.map(row => ({id: row.id, column: row[{{status|json}}], title: String(row[{{name|json}}] ?? 'Untitled'), subtitle: ({{meta|json}} || []).map(k => row[k]).filter(v => v != null && v !== '').map(v => Array.isArray(v) ? v.join(', ') : String(v)).join(' · ')}))
